book.name: Efesus
book.title: Fut kale Fol em Efesus Abiw Mutuk Fian em Sios Kawtiw ilo Dabalayemse Fut kale.

content: Sunbin-Got em Ibolow Win Sang em Weng te.

Beem mongom ete, ne Suda kawtiw num ibik biliw kawtiw yom abiw uneko, Kulais Yesus em Weng Kal Ken Ati be bakayem tem bakayem tem unemkabi te. Kate, nem kanemkakabi beem mongom ete kuw, i nelo sok am tem da konembiliw te.
Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Yu kililiwete: Sunbin-Got e nelo folok kenemeko, akalem wiin so amkoko, “Ku uneko, Suda kawtiw im ibik biliw kawtiw ikati nem ibolow folok kukuyema!”, nangse te.
Nangeko, em ibolow win sang be nem dim kaim dase te. Yu kililina! Yu nem kame kuw bosi weng be fukuneko,
iti teing bokoko, kal keko, bokolomeliw: “Feinka! E Kulais em ibolow win sang be kilele kal kebe kai!”, angboliwka!

Sua suaem kawtiw im dim e, Sunbin-Got e em ibolow win sang be kaim dim dalinba ke alenale kate kame, Sunbin-Finik e kalan kunum so, Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin kunum iso, alik num dim kel fein kaim dim dase te.

Ibolow win sang be kanekote: Sunbin-Got em Weng Kal Ken Ati be Suda kawtiw num ibik biliw kawtiw yuso, Suda kawtiw nuso, alik alik nulo bongguko, mongom makmak keyemse te. Keyemse kasike, Sunbin-Got em “Nulo Kulais em aluwbamin dim kel duyemoki te!”, yangse mesesem eisneng be nukalem alik alik makuw kulokoluw te.
Sunbin-Got e nelo ibolow folok kenemeko, amko konemsomi, bokonemomele: “Ku nem Weng Kal Ken Ati beem weng bakamin kunum kela!”, nangeko, aluwbamin beem kitil dunemse te.

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Ne sak wiin banim kunum keko, mali Sunbin-Got em galmose kunum waneng alik alik im ibik kunum kebi te. Kate, Sunbin-Got e nelo ibolow folok kenemeko, Kulais em sak kawtiw num ki ke fukuninba kelomin weng Weng Kal Ken Ati be nem teing dim dunemsomelei, mali Suda kawtiw num ibik biliw kawtiw yom gomet em dulum elote “Ku uneko, ibolow win sang be ilo kukuyem una!”, nangse te.

Nangeko, mesesem mesesem eisneng alik alik kaise Sunbin-Got be akalem ibolow win sang okiw da kolewalenale kate kame, e nelo mo konemei, ne em ibolow win sang be alik alik yom kiin dim kaim filel bakayemkabi te.

Keko beli, Sunbin-Got e akalem kal fian banban tulun kuw be akalem sios kunum waneng im dim ka kel dukuse kasike, abiil tikin em auk so kitil so finik ikati atemeko, kilele dolon keko, kal kebiliw te.

Fein! Sunbin-Got em kawin dim kaleem mesesem mesesem eisneng angom alik alik be talfut kelinba kese ding kabalak kel “Ne Kulais Yesus em teing dim kaneloki te!”, angse weng be kame nukalem Kamok Fian em dim kel ki kelewse te.
Ki kelewse kasike kame, nu finganinba kesomi, kitil kuw moko, Kulais elo “Fein!”, dangbuluw beem deiw bete Sunbin-Got em mit mewso unakabuluw te.

Keko kasike, yu kanelom nem yulo dakayembomi, anggil ilum kulabi beem ibolow fukunbomi, ibolow banban kemokoliw te! Nem Sunbin-Got em Weng Ken Ati be Bakabi beem dulum elote ne kal anggil ilum fian mak kulukabi kate, beem dulum elote yu kilele tokotoko wanengweng kesomi, sunsun kuw keko, Sunbin-Got eso boliw te.
Fol e Sunbin-Got eso Weng Bokose em Sang te.
Ne Aatim em kanese be ibolow fukunbomelei, diwkuw katin bukbuk angeko, em wiin daolewkabi kunum nete te.
Ete kuw kawin dim kaleem yelimel kumel so, abiil tikin em yelimel kumel so, alik alik yelimel kumel biim wiin duyemse Alew ete te.

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Ne Sunbin-Got elo dakalakabite: E akalem abiil tikin em kitil so auk so be kuluko, akalem Sunbin-Finik em teing dim dukulei, esik yom mutuk tem be akimeko, weneko, boka!

Belei, yukalem “Fein!”, angbiliw ibolow beem dulum elote Kulais e yom ibolow tem kel diwkuw bomaka! Belei, yom ibolow mutuk fian so dulew dulew kemin kukuw be atin kuw ais kimkim em kawin dim wentomo kitil kemin atew kebomaka!
Kebomelei, yuso, mali Sunbin-Got em galmose kunum waneng iso, yu bongguliwi, Sunbin-Got em kal fian mak so, bamdako, neng so, dak so, tiw so, kem unakabe kal fian
be kilele dolon kemoliwka!

Kebiliwi, yu Kulais em mali ilo atin kuw ibolow mutuk fian so dukayembin kukuw bakati kilele dolon keko, kal kekabiliw te. Kebiliw kano, Sunbin-Got akalem ete yom mutuk be atin kuw wenbele kano, yom kukuw be akalem kukuw atew keko, boke te.
Kitil so yom mutuk tem aluwkabe Sunbin-Got em wiin daolewkemuma! E ki keko, nukalem dakalaluw beem ki e bakileweko, neng so neng so uneko, num fukuninba dim elo uneko, nulo fein dokoyemkabe te.
Feinka! Kulais Yesus em wiin dim e kameem ding biliw so, sowem ding bokoliw so, alik alik sios kunum waneng nu diwkuw diwkuw Sunbin-Got em wiin fian fian kuw daolew kemuma! Feinka!

footnotes.text: 3:15 Gilik weng kaleem mongom mak e kanekote: “Ete kuw kawin dim kaleem yelimel kumel so, abiil tikin em yelimel kumel so, alik alik yelimel kumel biim alew kumel im yamtoloko, kakabe Alew ete te.”
3:18 Kal kawtiw mali mak im fukunin e kanekote: Fol e kale kel Sunbin-Got em “kal fian” beem dulum anginba kese kate, em “ibolow mutuk fian duyemkabe kukuw” beem dulum elote weng be fut tem bose te.
